notes: Three source tokens face the one word *Whosoever*. Rule 50 pins the *-soever* to ἄν and forbids leaving that particle empty, so ὃς ἄν takes the word and πᾶς is what is left unrepresented; the competing whole-cluster reading is named in the unit's note.
*call upon* keeps its particle inside the verb's unit, the object τὸ ὄνομα being accusative (rule 106).
κυρίου carries both the supplied determiner and the case preposition, no article standing (rules 21, 51).
